wanjiru.question: Are the fee notes being paid, and why not where they aren’t?
wanjiru.answer: 27% of what’s due is paid, on proof. A further KES 120,000 is paid on somebody’s word, with no proof yet. One fee note is behind, but the client is in touch.
wanjiru.answerFrom: Payments count as proven where a bank slip, an M-Pesa message or the accounting system’s record is filed on the fee note; everything else is from what people said in their check-ins.
